text:
clare: quick async pulse — what I did: locked down the content calendar for next week, queued the benchmark writeup draft, and uploaded initial social assets to Figma. blockers: publishing slot might clash with eng freeze window on Thursday; need a fast CR on the benchmark script so we can run final numbers. today: coordinate with eng for canary timing, finalize socials copy, and schedule the post once CR is green. cc @aj @ben for eng timing :calendar:

aj: I can take the CR. where's the branch? also can we run the bench with smaller seq len to save GPU time for the canary? :thinking_face:
clare: branch is `marketing/bench-final` in the monorepo, PR #827. small-seq run sounds fine — results will still be representative for our target workload.
ben: oncall til 14:00 PT but can squeeze a review around 13:30. if @aj wants me to approve after a quick pass, ping me.
olivia: just pushed a tiny copy tweak to the hero — changed "faster" -> "more consistent" to align w/ SLAs. updated Figma link: https://figma.com/file/abc123/redwood-campaign (commented on the CTA).
sam: social captions ready if we get the publishing window. two image sizes (1:1 and 16:9) uploaded. any last-minute A/B suggestions?
clare: +1 on CTA tweak, looks cleaner. for A/B, let's keep headline same but test two CTAs: "Try Redwood Inference" vs "Start free now". we'll only run A/B on the email list, not the blog.
aj: quick note on the bench script — I added a safety flag to avoid accidental full-run: `--dry-run` and `--max-tokens 2048`. use this to sanity-check before committing to the full run. code snippet:
```bash
# dry run example
python tools/run_benchmark.py --model-loc models/gpt-like --dataset bench/setA.json --dry-run --max-tokens 512
```
clare: perfect. once the CR is merged I'm happy to kick off the real run.
publishing-bot: scheduled post check: detected potential conflict — engineering maintenance window on 2026-03-19 02:00-04:00 UTC. Recommend scheduling outside that window. :robot_face:
ben: thanks for the flag, publishing-bot. if we shift to Friday morning (UTC), we should be clear. I can approve the canary fallback policy to use the smaller quantized variant if the main model is busy.
olivia: updated the blog meta to include `og:image` alt text for accessibility. left a note in the PR.
clare: action items summary: (1) @aj do the CR on #827 and use dry-run; (2) @ben review & approve by 13:30 PT if possible; (3) @olivia finalize assets and confirm sizes; (4) @sam hold social post until publishing window confirmed. I'll move the calendar to Friday morning if eng gives green light. ping here when done and I'll schedule. :raised_hands:
aj: taking the CR now, will update status in the PR once done.
ben: will try to review early. if I'm delayed I'll drop a comment with an ETA.
sam: ready to queue socials, waiting for the final publish time.
clare: thanks team — small, tight window but should be fine. I'll post a follow-up if we end up shifting to Friday. :sparkles:
